first = {
    value = 1
}
first = {
    value = 2
}
# Two INJECT: operations on one key are not two definitions of it: each
# contributes its own sub-blocks to an entry defined elsewhere and both
# apply. EU5120 must stay silent here.
INJECT:second = {
    value = 1
}
INJECT:second = {
    value = 2
}
